5.title: Marx's scheme and why law must wither away
5.text: The exercise class gives the Marxist construction in full, and without it one cannot understand why Soviet law looked the way it did. MARX AND ENGELS published the COMMUNIST MANIFESTO in 1848, followed by CAPITAL in 1867; MARX in doing so 'TURNS HEGEL UPSIDE DOWN'. THE SCHEME: HISTORY SINCE THE EMERGENCE OF PRIVATE PROPERTY IS CHARACTERIZED BY CLASS STRUGGLE, in which THE PROPERTIED CLASSES (THE BOURGEOISIE) EXPLOIT THE PROPERTYLESS CLASSES (THE PROLETARIAT). As wealth concentrates in the hands of ever fewer people, THE PROLETARIAT GROWS AND WILL ONE DAY SEIZE POWER. It will then establish the 'DICTATORSHIP OF THE PROLETARIAT', THAT IS, SOCIALISM. SOCIALISM, HOWEVER, IS ONLY A TRANSITIONAL STAGE; AFTER THE ABOLITION OF ALL PRIVATE PROPERTY A CLASSLESS SOCIETY WILL ARISE, THAT IS, COMMUNISM. AND NOW THE PART MOST IMPORTANT FOR A LAWYER, TO BE REMEMBERED VERBATIM: BECAUSE LAW AND THE STATE ARE NOTHING BUT A SUPERSTRUCTURE REPRESENTING THE INTERESTS OF THE BOURGEOISIE AND SERVING TO OPPRESS THE PEOPLE, THEY ARE TO 'WITHER AWAY' ONCE THE CLASS STRUGGLE IS OVERCOME AND A CLASSLESS SOCIETY ARISES. From this follows the whole paradox of Soviet law: a regime whose theory proclaims the disappearance of law had to go on making law for fifty years.

cards.q: What is Marx's scheme of history and where does socialism stand in it?
cards.a: HISTORY SINCE THE EMERGENCE OF PRIVATE PROPERTY IS CLASS STRUGGLE — the BOURGEOISIE exploits the PROLETARIAT; as wealth concentrates, the proletariat grows and WILL SEIZE POWER and establish the 'DICTATORSHIP OF THE PROLETARIAT', THAT IS, SOCIALISM. That is ONLY A TRANSITIONAL STAGE — after the abolition of all private property a CLASSLESS SOCIETY arises, that is, COMMUNISM.

cards.q: Why, according to Marx, must law wither away, and what paradox follows?
cards.a: Because LAW AND THE STATE ARE NOTHING BUT A SUPERSTRUCTURE REPRESENTING THE INTERESTS OF THE BOURGEOISIE AND SERVING TO OPPRESS THE PEOPLE — they are to 'WITHER AWAY' once the class struggle is overcome. The paradox: A REGIME WHOSE THEORY PROCLAIMS THE DISAPPEARANCE OF LAW HAD TO GO ON MAKING LAW FOR FIFTY YEARS.

6.title: Brest-Litovsk and self-determination including the colonies
6.text: THE TREATY OF BREST-LITOVSK (MARCH 1918) meant RUSSIA'S FINAL EXIT FROM THE FIRST WORLD WAR. And the exercise class attaches to it two consequences that surveys do not usually connect. (1) SOVIET RUSSIA HENCEFORTH SUPPORTED THE RIGHT OF ALL PEOPLES TO SELF-DETERMINATION, INCLUDING THE COLONIES. That is fundamental: Wilson's Fourteen Points spoke of self-determination for the peoples of Europe, but the Bolsheviks extended it to the colonies as well — and that is why the anti-colonial movements of the 20th century so often turned to Moscow. (2) THE RENUNCIATION OF RUSSIAN CLAIMS TO POLAND, BELARUS, UKRAINE, FINLAND, ESTONIA, LATVIA AND LITHUANIA. AND IN ADDITION — a detail valuable for global legal history — THE RENUNCIATION OF RUSSIAN EXTRATERRITORIAL RIGHTS AND CONCESSIONS IN CHINA. Soviet Russia was thus the first great power to leave the system of capitulations voluntarily. The exercise also recalls what was happening at the same time: THE TSAR AND HIS FAMILY WERE KILLED BY THE BOLSHEVIKS and A CIVIL WAR FOLLOWED THAT LASTED UNTIL 1921. IN 1922 THE USSR CAME INTO BEING BY THE UNION OF SOVIET RUSSIA WITH UKRAINE, BELARUS AND TRANSCAUCASIA.

cards.q: What did the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk mean and which two consequences did it have?
cards.a: RUSSIA'S FINAL EXIT FROM THE FIRST WORLD WAR (March 1918). 1) Soviet Russia henceforth SUPPORTED THE RIGHT OF ALL PEOPLES TO SELF-DETERMINATION, INCLUDING THE COLONIES — whereas Wilson meant it for Europe; hence the anti-colonial movements turned to Moscow. 2) THE RENUNCIATION OF CLAIMS to Poland, Belarus, Ukraine, Finland and the Baltic, and in addition THE RENUNCIATION OF RUSSIAN EXTRATERRITORIAL RIGHTS AND CONCESSIONS IN CHINA.

8.title: Consumer goods and the means of production
8.text: To the question of property in the USSR the exercise class answers with a single distinction, and it is the cleanest formulation one can have. THE PROPERTY REGIME WAS CHARACTERIZED BY ITS DIVISION INTO CONSUMER GOODS AND THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION. PRIVATE PROPERTY EXISTED — APART FROM A FEW MINOR EXCEPTIONS — ONLY IN CONSUMER GOODS. It is therefore not true that private property did not exist; IT DID NOT EXIST IN THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION. AND THE SOURCE IS A TEXTBOOK EXAMPLE: LAND IS THE FOREMOST EXAMPLE OF A MEANS OF PRODUCTION. The exercise then adds what this meant in practice: PEASANTS WERE EXPROPRIATED ON A LARGE SCALE, OFTEN BY VIOLENT MEANS. That distinction is at the same time the key to the whole Marxist legal logic: whoever owns a means of production can hire the labour of others and appropriate the surplus value — and that is why it is precisely this kind of property that is forbidden, not property as such.

cards.q: How exactly was property regulated in the USSR?
cards.a: The regime was characterized by the DIVISION INTO CONSUMER GOODS AND THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION: PRIVATE PROPERTY EXISTED — apart from minor exceptions — ONLY IN CONSUMER GOODS. It is therefore not true that it did not exist; IT DID NOT EXIST IN THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION, of which LAND is the foremost example. In practice this meant that PEASANTS WERE EXPROPRIATED ON A LARGE SCALE, OFTEN VIOLENTLY.

10.title: Austromarxism
10.text: The exercise class adds the Austrian branch, worth knowing for this course because it is a domestic contribution to a world debate. FROM 1904 A CIRCLE OF SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC INTELLECTUALS INSPIRED BY MARXISM — OTTO BAUER, KARL RENNER, MAX ADLER AND RUDOLF HILFERDING — FORMED A THEORETICAL CURRENT WITHIN THE SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC WORKERS' PARTY (SDAP), called AUSTROMARXISM. It is worth noting who is on that list: KARL RENNER became the first chancellor of the republic in 1918 and then the first president of the Second Republic in 1945; OTTO BAUER was foreign minister. Austromarxism is therefore remarkable in that it was NOT MERELY AN ACADEMIC SCHOOL BUT THE THINKING OF PEOPLE WHO AFTERWARDS ACTUALLY GOVERNED — and its characteristic feature was the search for a THIRD WAY between revolutionary Bolshevism and reformism, especially on the national question, where Renner and Bauer proposed PERSONAL (rather than territorial) AUTONOMY for nationalities — a solution that suggested itself in a multinational monarchy and is still cited today in debates on minority rights.

terms.def: Renner and Bauer's solution to the national question: a nationality's rights attach to the person, not to a territory.

cards.q: What is Austromarxism and what is remarkable about it?
cards.a: From 1904 a THEORETICAL CURRENT WITHIN THE SDAP, formed by OTTO BAUER, KARL RENNER, MAX ADLER and RUDOLF HILFERDING. It is remarkable in that it was NOT MERELY AN ACADEMIC SCHOOL BUT THE THINKING OF PEOPLE WHO AFTERWARDS GOVERNED (Renner was the first chancellor in 1918 and the first president in 1945). It sought a THIRD WAY between Bolshevism and reformism and on the national question proposed PERSONAL, not territorial, AUTONOMY.
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG I

13.title: The Habsburg Law and the emperor who did not abdicate
13.text: For the Austrian republic the exercise class gives a detail that is legally very interesting and easily overlooked. AFTER THE PROCLAMATION OF THE AUSTRIAN REPUBLIC IN NOVEMBER 1918 THE EMPEROR CHARLES RENOUNCED 'HIS SHARE IN THE AFFAIRS OF STATE' — BUT HE DID NOT RENOUNCE THE THRONE. That is not hair-splitting: renouncing the exercise of power is not abdication, so from a monarchist point of view he remained emperor and his claim persisted. And that this was not theory is shown by what followed: IN 1921 CHARLES ATTEMPTED TO REGAIN THE HUNGARIAN THRONE, and twice at that. IT THEREFORE SEEMED NECESSARY TO ENACT THE 'HABSBURG LAW' (HABSBURGERGESETZ) FOR THE PROTECTION OF THE YOUNG REPUBLIC — it banished the members of the house, confiscated their property and made return conditional on an express renunciation of claims and recognition of the republic. CHARLES AND HIS FAMILY WENT INTO EXILE, FIRST TO SWITZERLAND AND THEN TO MADEIRA, WHERE HE DIED IN 1922. It is a fine example of how a constitutional break does not happen by a single act: a republic must secure its existence even against a legal title that has not formally lapsed.

cards.q: Did the Emperor Charles abdicate, and why was the Habsburg Law enacted?
cards.a: HE DID NOT — he renounced only 'HIS SHARE IN THE AFFAIRS OF STATE', BUT NOT THE THRONE, so his claim formally persisted; in 1921 he attempted TO REGAIN THE HUNGARIAN THRONE. Hence it seemed necessary to enact the HABSBURGERGESETZ FOR THE PROTECTION OF THE YOUNG REPUBLIC. Charles went into exile to Switzerland and then to MADEIRA, where he DIED IN 1922.
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG I

14.title: What the B-VG is made of
14.text: The exercise class analyses the origin of the individual parts of the constitution, and that is the best answer to the question what the B-VG actually is. LARGE PARTS OF THE B-VG WERE TAKEN OVER FROM THE DECEMBER CONSTITUTION (1867) — that is, from the monarchy; THE PROVISIONS CONCERNING THE REPUBLIC WERE OFTEN INSPIRED BY THE 'WEIMAR CONSTITUTION', the German constitution of 1919. AND ENTIRELY NEW WERE THE PROVISIONS ON THE CONSTITUTIONAL COURT (VfGH), FORMULATED LARGELY BY HANS KELSEN, WHICH CREATE A SYSTEM OF CONSTITUTIONAL JURISDICTION — THAT IS, JUDICIAL REVIEW OF NORMS, OF STATUTES AND OF REGULATIONS. Remember that trio as a whole: OLD AUSTRIAN LAW, GERMAN REPUBLICAN INSPIRATION, AND ONE ENTIRELY NEW THING THAT IS A WORLD FIRST. Two territorial details the exercise stresses and which the examiner likes to ask about: BURGENLAND WAS NOT YET PART OF AUSTRIA AT THE TIME and VIENNA WAS PART OF LOWER AUSTRIA UNTIL 1922. The B-VG underwent significant revisions in 1925 (the administrative reform).

cards.q: From which three sources is the B-VG composed?
cards.a: 1) LARGE PARTS TAKEN OVER FROM THE DECEMBER CONSTITUTION (1867), that is, from the monarchy. 2) THE PROVISIONS ON THE REPUBLIC inspired by the WEIMAR CONSTITUTION (1919). 3) ENTIRELY NEW are the PROVISIONS ON THE CONSTITUTIONAL COURT (VfGH), formulated largely by KELSEN — a system of CONSTITUTIONAL JURISDICTION with JUDICIAL REVIEW OF STATUTES AND REGULATIONS, and that is a world first.
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG II

cards.q: Which two territorial peculiarities applied to Austria in 1920?
cards.a: BURGENLAND WAS NOT YET PART OF AUSTRIA and VIENNA WAS PART OF LOWER AUSTRIA UNTIL 1922. The B-VG then underwent significant revisions in 1925 (the administrative reform).
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG II

15.title: From Schattendorf to the burning of the Palace of Justice
15.text: The exercise class gives the chain of events that led to the 1929 amendment, and it is worth knowing in full, because it shows how a constitutional change arises out of a single verdict. THE SCHATTENDORF SHOOTING OF 1927: THREE MEMBERS OF A NATIONALIST PARAMILITARY ORGANIZATION KILLED TWO MEMBERS OF THE SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC REPUBLICAN SCHUTZBUND — and they were ACQUITTED. THE REVOLT PROVOKED BY THAT ACQUITTAL culminated in the BURNING OF THE VIENNA PALACE OF JUSTICE, when THE POLICE FIRED INTO THE OUTRAGED CROWD: 89 DEMONSTRATORS AND FIVE POLICEMEN DIED, MORE THAN 600 DEMONSTRATORS AND ABOUT 600 POLICEMEN WERE INJURED. THE CONSEQUENCE: FEAR OF A 'HEIMWEHR' PUTSCH EVENTUALLY LED TO THE REVISION OF THE CONSTITUTION IN 1929. Note the causality — the constitution did not change because views on the separation of powers had changed, but BECAUSE THE GOVERNMENT FEARED A PUTSCH AND PREFERRED TO GIVE WAY. Then came the GREAT DEPRESSION OF 1929 and DEMOCRACY CAME UNDER EVER GREATER PRESSURE, until in 1934–1938 the AUSTROFASCIST REGIME ('STÄNDESTAAT') UNDER DOLLFUSS AND SCHUSCHNIGG took over.

cards.q: What chain of events led to the amendment of the Austrian constitution in 1929?
cards.a: THE SCHATTENDORF SHOOTING OF 1927 — three nationalist paramilitaries killed two members of the REPUBLICAN SCHUTZBUND and were ACQUITTED. The revolt provoked by the acquittal culminated in the BURNING OF THE VIENNA PALACE OF JUSTICE; THE POLICE FIRED INTO THE CROWD, 89 DEMONSTRATORS AND FIVE POLICEMEN DIED. FEAR OF A 'HEIMWEHR' PUTSCH then led to the REVISION OF THE CONSTITUTION IN 1929 — the constitution therefore changed not because of views on the separation of powers but BECAUSE THE GOVERNMENT FEARED A PUTSCH.
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG II

17.title: Authoritarian or fascist? Austria 1934–38
17.text: The exercise class expressly opens this question as CONTESTED and refers for arguments on both sides to the textbook — which means that in the exam you are expected to KNOW BOTH SIDES, not to pick one. THE SEQUENCE OF EVENTS: IN MARCH 1933 AN INCIDENT IN THE NATIONAL COUNCIL OVERTURNED THE COUNTRY'S PARLIAMENTARY AND DEMOCRATIC SYSTEM — the exercise calls it outright a PUTSCH. (In a contested vote all three presidents of the chamber resigned one after another, and the government construed this as the parliament's 'self-elimination'.) THE DOLLFUSS GOVERNMENT THEN RULED BY SO-CALLED EMERGENCY DECREES. THE FEBRUARY UPRISING OF 1934 LED TO CIVIL WAR. THE MAY CONSTITUTION OF 1934 MARKS THE BREAK WITH THE B-VG: IT ESTABLISHED THE SO-CALLED CORPORATE STATE (STÄNDESTAAT) AND CREATED A SINGLE PARTY. ARGUMENTS FOR CALLING IT 'FASCIST': a single party, paramilitary organizations, the leader principle, the abolition of parliament and free elections, the suppression of social democracy by civil war. ARGUMENTS AGAINST: the regime rested on CATHOLIC CORPORATIST DOCTRINE (the encyclical Quadragesimo anno), not on racism; it had no totalitarian claim on the whole person; and it defined itself against Nazism and was in the end swept away by it. That is why one usually speaks today of AUSTROFASCISM or of a CLERICAL-AUTHORITARIAN REGIME — something in between.

cards.q: How did Austria arrive at the corporate state in 1934?
cards.a: IN MARCH 1933 AN INCIDENT IN THE NATIONAL COUNCIL OVERTURNED the parliamentary and democratic system — the exercise calls it a PUTSCH (in a contested vote all three presidents of the chamber resigned and the government construed this as the parliament's 'self-elimination'). THE DOLLFUSS GOVERNMENT then ruled by EMERGENCY DECREES; THE FEBRUARY UPRISING OF 1934 led to CIVIL WAR; THE MAY CONSTITUTION OF 1934 marks the BREAK WITH THE B-VG, establishing the CORPORATE STATE and a SINGLE PARTY.
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG II

cards.q: Was the Austrian regime of 1934–38 fascist? Arguments on both sides.
cards.a: FOR: a single party, paramilitary organizations, the leader principle, the abolition of parliament and elections, the suppression of social democracy by civil war. AGAINST: it rested on CATHOLIC CORPORATIST DOCTRINE (Quadragesimo anno), NOT ON RACISM; it had no TOTALITARIAN CLAIM ON THE WHOLE PERSON; and it defined itself against Nazism and was swept away by it. Hence one speaks of AUSTROFASCISM or a CLERICAL-AUTHORITARIAN REGIME.
cards.topic: The Austrian 1st Republic, Democracy and the B-VG II

19.title: Hitler's seizure of power 'in accordance with the law'
19.text: The exercise class makes two claims about Hitler that sound uncomfortable, and it is therefore worth knowing them precisely. (1) ALREADY DURING HIS IMPRISONMENT IN 1924 HITLER DECIDED TO SEIZE POWER IN GERMANY NOT BY FORCE BUT BY DEMOCRATIC MEANS. After the failed Munich putsch he chose the electoral route — which matters for legal history, because the whole question of the abusability of democratic forms follows from it. IN 1932 THE NSDAP WON A RELATIVE MAJORITY IN THE REICHSTAG and IN 1933 HITLER WAS APPOINTED CHANCELLOR BY HINDENBURG; STEP BY STEP HE TURNED THE WEIMAR REPUBLIC INTO A FASCIST DICTATORSHIP (THE 'THIRD REICH'), with MUSSOLINI'S DICTATORSHIP IN ITALY SERVING AS HIS MODEL. After HINDENBURG'S DEATH IN 1934 HE TOOK OVER HIS FUNCTIONS AS 'FÜHRER AND REICH CHANCELLOR'. (2) AND NOW THE SENTENCE TO REMEMBER VERBATIM, BECAUSE IT IS EXACTLY THE LEGAL-HISTORICAL PROBLEM: HITLER'S SEIZURE OF POWER WAS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAW AND THE WEIMAR CONSTITUTION WAS NEVER FORMALLY REPEALED. The dictatorship therefore did not need to remove the constitution — it was enough to leave it on paper and hollow it out. That is the strongest argument against a purely formal conception of legality and at the same time the reason why post-war constitutions introduce a material core that cannot be amended.

cards.q: Which route to power did Hitler choose, and from when?
cards.a: ALREADY DURING HIS IMPRISONMENT IN 1924 HE DECIDED TO SEIZE POWER NOT BY FORCE BUT BY DEMOCRATIC MEANS — after the failed Munich putsch he chose the electoral route. In 1932 the NSDAP won a RELATIVE MAJORITY, in 1933 he was appointed chancellor by HINDENBURG, after whose death in 1934 he took over his functions as 'FÜHRER AND REICH CHANCELLOR'. His model was MUSSOLINI'S DICTATORSHIP.

cards.q: How does the exercise class assess the legality of Hitler's seizure of power, and what follows?
cards.a: 'HITLER'S SEIZURE OF POWER WAS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAW AND THE WEIMAR CONSTITUTION WAS NEVER FORMALLY REPEALED.' The dictatorship therefore did not need to remove the constitution — IT WAS ENOUGH TO LEAVE IT ON PAPER AND HOLLOW IT OUT. It is the strongest argument against a PURELY FORMAL CONCEPTION OF LEGALITY and the reason why post-war constitutions introduce a MATERIAL CORE that cannot be amended.

22.title: Race as an 'objective' characteristic, and why the grandparents' religion decides
22.text: The exercise class formulates the core of the Nuremberg laws through the concept of the nation, and that is the best explanation one can have. THE SO-CALLED 'NUREMBERG RACE LAWS', ENACTED IN THE GERMAN CITY OF NUREMBERG IN 1935, WERE CHARACTERISTIC OF AN IDEOLOGY ACCORDING TO WHICH THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE WAS REGARDED AS A 'NATURAL UNITY' AND MEMBERSHIP OF THAT GROUP WAS DETERMINED BY 'OBJECTIVE' CHARACTERISTICS — THAT IS, BY RACE. And the exercise adds a golden distinction: IT IS A COUNTER-MOVEMENT TO THE VOLUNTARIST CONCEPTION OF THE NATION, and precisely in that lies THE DIFFERENCE FROM 19TH-CENTURY ANTI-SEMITISM. The voluntarist conception (Renan's 'daily plebiscite') says that a nation is a matter of WILL AND AVOWAL; the racial conception says it is a matter of DESCENT, about which nothing can be changed. FROM THE LAW IT FOLLOWS: ONLY SOMEONE OF 'GERMAN BLOOD' (AN ARYAN) WAS REGARDED AS A CITIZEN OF THE GERMAN REICH. AND THE POINT THAT CONVICTS THAT IDEOLOGY: WHETHER SOMEONE WAS AN 'ARYAN', A 'JEW' OR A 'MISCHLING' DEPENDED ABOVE ALL ON THE RELIGIOUS DENOMINATION OF THE GRANDPARENTS — THREE OR FOUR JEWISH GRANDPARENTS MEANT A 'JEW', REGARDLESS OF WHAT THE PERSON HIMSELF WAS. That is: a law claiming that blood decides has in the end to establish it from a parish register.

cards.q: Which conception of the nation did the Nuremberg laws set themselves against?
cards.a: Against the VOLUNTARIST CONCEPTION OF THE NATION — and precisely in that lies THE DIFFERENCE FROM 19TH-CENTURY ANTI-SEMITISM. The voluntarist conception says a nation is a matter of WILL AND AVOWAL; the racial one that it is a matter of DESCENT, about which nothing can be changed. The people of the state was regarded as a 'NATURAL UNITY' determined by 'OBJECTIVE' CHARACTERISTICS, that is, by RACE.

cards.q: How was it determined in practice who was a 'Jew', and what does that reveal about the ideology?
cards.a: ABOVE ALL BY THE RELIGIOUS DENOMINATION OF THE GRANDPARENTS: THREE OR FOUR JEWISH GRANDPARENTS MEANT A 'JEW', REGARDLESS OF WHAT THE PERSON HIMSELF WAS. It reveals that A LAW CLAIMING THAT BLOOD DECIDES HAS IN THE END TO ESTABLISH IT FROM A PARISH REGISTER. Only someone of 'GERMAN BLOOD' (an Aryan) was a citizen of the German Reich.
